verses.text: 'As for you, take up a lamentation for the princes of Israel
verses.textZh: 你當為以色列的王作起哀歌，

verses.text: and say, 'What was your mother? A lioness among lions! She lay down among young lions, She reared her cubs.
verses.textZh: 說：你的母親是甚麼呢？是個母獅子，蹲伏在獅子中間，在少壯獅子中養育小獅子。

verses.text: 'When she brought up one of her cubs, He became a lion, And he learned to tear [his] prey; He devoured men.
verses.textZh: 在他小獅子中養大一個，成了少壯獅子，學會抓食而吃人。

verses.text: 'Then nations heard about him; He was captured in their pit, And they brought him with hooks To the land of Egypt.
verses.textZh: 列國聽見了就把他捉在他們的坑中，用鉤子拉到埃及地去。

verses.text: 'When she saw, as she waited, [That] her hope was lost, She took another of her cubs And made him a young lion.
verses.textZh: 母獅見自己等候失了指望，就從他小獅子中又將一個養為少壯獅子。

verses.text: 'And he walked about among the lions; He became a young lion, He learned to tear [his] prey; He devoured men.
verses.textZh: 他在眾獅子中走來走去，成了少壯獅子，學會抓食而吃人。

verses.text: 'He destroyed their fortified towers And laid waste their cities; And the land and its fullness were appalled Because of the sound of his roaring.
verses.textZh: 他知道列國的宮殿，又使他們的城邑變為荒場；因他咆哮的聲音，遍地和其中所有的就都荒廢。

verses.text: 'Then nations set against him On every side from [their] provinces, And they spread their net over him; He was captured in their pit.
verses.textZh: 於是四圍邦國各省的人來攻擊他，將網撒在他身上，捉在他們的坑中。

verses.text: 'They put him in a cage with hooks And brought him to the king of Babylon; They brought him in hunting nets So that his voice would be heard no more On the mountains of Israel.
verses.textZh: 他們用鉤子鉤住他，將他放在籠中，帶到巴比倫王那裡，將他放入堅固之所，使他的聲音在以色列山上不再聽見。

verses.text: 'Your mother was like a vine in your vineyard, Planted by the waters; It was fruitful and full of branches Because of abundant waters.
verses.textZh: 你的母親先前如葡萄樹，極其茂盛（原文是在你血中），栽於水旁。因為水多，就多結果子，滿生枝子；

verses.text: 'And it had strong branches [fit] for scepters of rulers, And its height was raised above the clouds So that it was seen in its height with the mass of its branches.
verses.textZh: 生出堅固的枝幹，可作掌權者的杖。這枝幹高舉在茂密的枝中，而且他生長高大，枝子繁多，遠遠可見。

verses.text: 'But it was plucked up in fury; It was cast down to the ground; And the east wind dried up its fruit. Its strong branch was torn off So that it withered; The fire consumed it.
verses.textZh: 但這葡萄樹因忿怒被拔出摔在地上；東風吹乾其上的果子，堅固的枝幹折斷枯乾，被火燒燬了；

verses.text: 'And now it is planted in the wilderness, In a dry and thirsty land.
verses.textZh: 如今栽於曠野乾旱無水之地。

verses.text: 'And fire has gone out from [its] branch; It has consumed its shoots [and] fruit, So that there is not in it a strong branch, A scepter to rule.'' This is a lamentation, and has become a lamentation.
verses.textZh: 火也從他枝幹中發出，燒滅果子，以致沒有堅固的枝幹可作掌權者的杖。這是哀歌，也必用以作哀歌。
